result.explanation: Uses the required atomic guarded-batch rule: validation precedes version, conflict, and capacity checks; rejected requests preserve state, while successful non-identical candidates increment version once.
result.mapping: Registers map to state.values, optimistic version maps to state.v, and capacity maps to state.cap. The optional archival rule does not transfer: this task concerns live atomic state, not provenance or original order.
result.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated JSON and numeric constraints. Update keys are accepted when guarded; newly introduced keys become registers because the specification explicitly invalidates unknown guard keys, not unknown update keys.
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){if(state===null)state={v:0,values:Object.assign({},config.initial),cap:config.capacity};var val=state.values, v=state.v, invalid=false, g=event.guards||{},u=event.updates||{},ks=Object.keys(g),us=Object.keys(u);for(var i=0;i<ks.length;i++)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(val,ks[i]))invalid=true;for(i=0;i<us.length;i++)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g,us[i])||u[us[i]]<0)invalid=true;var status,changed=[];if(invalid)status='invalid';else if(event.version!==v)status='stale';else{for(i=0;i<ks.length;i++)if(val[ks[i]]!==g[ks[i]]){status='conflict';break}if(!status){var cand=Object.assign({},val);for(i=0;i<us.length;i++)cand[us[i]]=u[us[i]];var sum=0;Object.keys(cand).forEach(function(k){sum+=cand[k]});if(sum>state.cap)status='capacity';else{for(i=0;i<us.length;i++)if(val[us[i]]!==cand[us[i]])changed.push(us[i]);changed.sort(function(a,b){var A=Array.from(a),B=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(A.length,B.length);for(var j=0;j<n;j++){var d=A[j].codePointAt(0)-B[j].codePointAt(0);if(d)return d}return A.length-B.length});if(changed.length){val=cand;v++;status='committed'}else status='unchanged'}}}var out={status:status,version:v,values:Object.assign({},val),changed:status==='committed'?changed:[]};return{state:{v:v,values:val,cap:state.cap},output:out}}
